Hot Pears
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 9:07am

Ingredients




Pears
1 cup sugar
2 cups water
Hot cinnamon drops, optional
Peel, quarter and core several pears.

Preparation

1 Simmer in syrup of sugar and water until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. 2 For added zest, dissolve hot cinnamon drops in the syrup before adding to the pears.
